description:
## Problem
results-data/bundles/duckdb-version-matrix/ holds 28 files that are each a median of several runs, written 2026-08-29, with a configured stream count and inconsistent stamps (R). Methodology answer 3 asks for every run.

## Change
- Look for the individual run files (~/Developer/benchmark_runs/duckdb-version-matrix-20260829-sf10 and -v2). Where all runs of a median exist and pass validate_submission.py --trust-internal-source, stage them with make corpus-stage-local and replace the median file. Where they do not, keep the median file and label it "median of N runs; individual runs not published" through the rule's labels (owner decision 12).
- The 7 TPC-H files carry a known data defect and stay excluded; duckdb-sf10-tpch-defective-datagen-rerun owns their rerun.

- Replacing deletes a stored path. docs/internal/results-phase-2-runbook.md forbids that while the A0 freeze is active. The owner released these 28 paths on 2026-11-22 (crr-00 decision 12). The pull request must: amend the runbook to record the release and its scope (these paths only); include the inventory the runbook asks for (Git history, workflow artifacts, caches, mirrors, inventory and link consequences, old public result ids that stop resolving); and be followed by a deletion-only pull request on published-results, because the mirror is a union overlay and a deletion on develop does not reach it.

## Decision gates
- Replace a median file only when every one of its runs exists and validates. Otherwise keep that file and label it; never delete without the full replacement.
- Never edit a run file. Record each kept median and why in CORPUS_NOTES.md.
- The release covers only these 28 paths. Deleting any other stored path: stop and report.
- Do not claim that public bytes are gone; state what remains in Git history.
- A deletion-only pull request on published-results follows the owner decision of 2026-11-24: merge after green CI and an independent review with no Critical or Required findings, posting a stand-in that cites that review.

## Guardrails (apply to every item of this plan)
- Fix the root cause for every platform and benchmark. No rule, exception, label or test may name a platform or a version matrix. Only the pvm-p* items may name Polars, and only to run and stage that run's files.
- Never edit a stored result file to make it pass. Outcomes change only through the rule.
- Any change to the outcome of a stored result must show in the committed outcome snapshot diff in the same pull request and be explained in its body.
- No new stored class value. No reader may decide anything from benchmark.compliance_class, conformance_class or summary.tpc_metrics.suppressed.
- Paths, line numbers and counts in this plan were read on 2026-11-22 at develop 93f3360. Re-read before editing; report drift, do not guess.
- AGENTS.md applies: linked worktree, one pull request per item, close at the merged pull request, heavy work only through make heavy-run, no live cloud run without owner approval in that task.
- At a decision gate, follow the recorded default. If its stop condition is met, stop and report to the owner. Never substitute a different owner decision.
- Read crr-00-corpus-rule-remediation-plan first: it holds the owner decisions, the rule table and the fault types (T1 to T5).
